description: JoomPulse gives you instant access to MercadoLivre Brazil's marketplace data through natural language queries. Analyze product listings, categories, sellers, pricing trends, reviews, and keywords — all powered by a structured data warehouse. Whether you're doing competitive research, category analysis, or tracking listing performance, JoomPulse translates your questions into precise data insights without writing a single line of SQL. Built for e-commerce teams and analysts who need fast, reliable answers from Brazil's largest online marketplace.
